# preferred-languages

Track the user's preferred languages (`navigator.languages`).


## API

### `usePreferredLanguages`

Track the user's preferred languages (`navigator.languages`). Updates on `languagechange`. The default host is gated on `window`, so Node's own `navigator` never leaks the server locale into the render; server renders expose `ssrLanguages`. The listener is removed with the owning reactive scope.

```ts
function usePreferredLanguages( options: UsePreferredLanguagesOptions = {}, ): Readonly<Ref<readonly string[]>>
```

## Types

### `PreferredLanguagesHost`

Window-like capability observed by `usePreferredLanguages`.

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navigator` | `{ readonly languages: readonly string[]; readonly language?: string }` | Navigator exposing the user's languages. |

### `UsePreferredLanguagesOptions`

Options for `usePreferredLanguages`.

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ssrLanguages`? | `readonly string[]` | Languages exposed during server rendering. Pass the request's `Accept-Language` list to keep hydration stable. |
| `host`? | `MaybeRefOrGetter<PreferredLanguagesHost \| null \| undefined>` | Reactive window capability for alternate runtimes and tests. |
